div.div: Each row is one scenario. A job enters its GitHub environment, applies its per-run Terraform roots and reaches its targets; a maintainer applies the one-time roots, whose outputs become environment secrets or test variables. Every cloud scenario, from object store and KEK to the platform and worker clusters, uses the dedicated account that the landing zone creates in each cloud.
